% Robustness--accuracy tradeoff along the training trajectory.
% Data (generated by make_budget_macros.py from results/ojcoms/dense_eval.csv):
%   data/fig_frontier_seeds.csv  per-seed trajectories (7 training seeds, 26 checkpoints each)
%   data/fig_frontier_traj.csv   mean and 95 % t-interval over seeds
%   data/fig_frontier_conv.csv   checkpoint with the best matched accuracy of each run
%   data/fig_frontier_sel_{fe,mbler}.csv  checkpoints chosen by the two stopping rules (held-out seeds)
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{groupplot}[group style={group size=2 by 2, horizontal sep=1.5cm, vertical sep=1.6cm},
  ieee wide, height=0.26\textwidth]
% ---------------- (a) matched accuracy ----------------
\nextgroupplot[title={(a) Matched channel}, xmin=0, xmax=51000,
  xtick={0,10000,20000,30000,40000,50000}, xticklabels={$0$,$1$,$2$,$3$,$4$,$5$},
  scaled x ticks=false, xlabel={Training iteration $t$ ($\times 10^{4}$)},
  ylabel={$\gamma_{0.1}(\theta_t)$ (dB)}, ymin=0.7, ymax=2.2]
\def\S{data/fig_frontier_seeds.csv}
\pgfplotsinvokeforeach{2,...,8}{\addplot[gray!55, line width=0.4pt, mark=none, forget plot] table[x=step, y=snr_s#1] {\S};}
\addplot[cAINR, line width=1.3pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=snr] {data/fig_frontier_traj.csv};
% ---------------- (b) shifted channels ----------------
\nextgroupplot[title={(b) Shifted channels, SNR $5$~dB}, xmin=0, xmax=51000, ymode=log,
  ymin=1e-4, ymax=1, xtick={0,10000,20000,30000,40000,50000},
  xticklabels={$0$,$1$,$2$,$3$,$4$,$5$}, scaled x ticks=false,
  xlabel={Training iteration $t$ ($\times 10^{4}$)}, ylabel={Block error rate},
  legend pos=south east]
\def\S{data/fig_frontier_seeds.csv}
\pgfplotsinvokeforeach{2,...,8}{\addplot[gray!55, line width=0.4pt, mark=none, forget plot] table[x=step, y=S2_s#1] {\S};}
\addplot[cDisc, line width=1.3pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=S2] {data/fig_frontier_traj.csv};
\addlegendentry{S2, mean}
\addplot[black, line width=0.9pt, densely dashed, mark=none] table[x=step, y=DS] {data/fig_frontier_traj.csv};
\addlegendentry{$1000$~ns, mean}
\addlegendimage{gray!55, line width=0.4pt}\addlegendentry{S2, per run}
% ---------------- (c) frontier ----------------
\nextgroupplot[title={(c) Robustness--accuracy frontier}, ymode=log, ymin=1e-4, ymax=1,
  xmin=-0.05, xmax=1.3, xlabel={Matched cost $\Delta(\theta_t)$ (dB)},
  ylabel={$P_{\mathrm{S2}}(\theta_t)$}, legend pos=south east, legend columns=1]
\fill[gray!12] (axis cs:-0.05,1e-4) rectangle (axis cs:0.30,1);
\def\S{data/fig_frontier_seeds.csv}
\pgfplotsinvokeforeach{2,...,8}{\addplot[gray!60, line width=0.45pt, mark=none, forget plot] table[x=cost_s#1, y=S2_s#1] {\S};}
\draw[densely dashed, black, line width=0.6pt] (axis cs:0.30,1e-4) -- (axis cs:0.30,1);
\node[anchor=north west, font=\scriptsize, inner sep=1pt] at (axis cs:0.315,0.95) {$\epsilon$};
\addplot[only marks, mark=*, mark size=1.8pt, black] table[x=cost, y=S2] {data/fig_frontier_conv.csv};
\addlegendentry{$t_{\mathrm{match}}$}
\addplot[only marks, mark=square*, mark size=1.9pt, draw=cAINR, fill=white, line width=0.7pt]
  table[x=cost, y=S2] {data/fig_frontier_sel_fe.csv};
\addlegendentry{R1, free energy}
\addplot[only marks, mark=triangle*, mark size=2.2pt, draw=cDisc, fill=white, line width=0.7pt]
  table[x=cost, y=S2] {data/fig_frontier_sel_mbler.csv};
\addlegendentry{R2, matched}
% ---------------- (d) pilot-noise tolerance ----------------
\nextgroupplot[title={(d) Pilot-noise tolerance}, xmin=0, xmax=51000,
  xtick={0,10000,20000,30000,40000,50000}, xticklabels={$0$,$1$,$2$,$3$,$4$,$5$},
  scaled x ticks=false, xlabel={Training iteration $t$ ($\times 10^{4}$)},
  ylabel={Extra pilot noise (dB)}]
\def\T{data/fig_frontier_traj.csv}
\ciband{\T}{step}{ptol}{cOrange}
\addplot[cOrange!80!black, line width=1.1pt, mark=none] table[x=step, y=ptol] {\T};
\end{groupplot}
\end{tikzpicture}
